limitations: Invariant source generic classes/interfaces with explicit construction, class bounds, typed fields/members, transitive parameterized inheritance and required erased bridges. Existing generic functions/imported generic classes are prerequisites and excluded as new support.

Declaration-site variance, dependent/F-bounds, interface bounds, classifier generic member functions, generic interface defaults, nested generic classifiers/companions and type-parameter shadowing remain explicit unsupported boundaries. Constructor type inference requires explicit arguments.

One actual unchanged AndroidBible source and two unchanged pinned upstream originals; fixed Java bytecodes, class verification, generic JVM signatures and official Kotlin metadata consumers. No full-app, device, performance or exhaustive-language claim.
